title: Mu'ujizar Shaida Mai Shiru
intro: Za ka gamu da wani mutum mai ɓoye labarin shiga tsakani na Allah. Labarin tanadin mu'ujiza da kuma kariya mara magana wanda ke bayyana a tsawon lokaci. Za ka iya gano wanda ya fuskanci wannan gwaji mai ban mamaki?
clues: Na sami wani sako na allahntaka wanda ya bani mamaki
Mutanena sun yi tambaya game da tsarkina lokacin da na dawo da yaro
An umarce ni da in yi azumi daga yin magana na ɗan lokaci
Wani maɓuɓɓugar ruwa da dabino ne suka ci gaba da riƙe ni a lokacin gwaji na
Ubangijina ya yi girgizar bishiya mai ban mamaki don ya ciyar da ni
Mala'ika ya bayyana a gare ni a cikin siffar mutum cikakke

trial.label: Gwaji/Taron
options: Haihuwa ita kaɗai a ƙarƙashin bishiyar dabino
A jefa shi cikin rami mai zafi
trial.answer: Haihuwa ita kaɗai a ƙarƙashin bishiyar dabino

outcome.label: Sakamako
options: An tabbatar da rashin laifina lokacin da ɗana jariri ya yi magana
An halaka mutanena da azabar Allah
Na jagoranci al'ummata zuwa ga nasara
Rijiyar mu'ujiza ta bayyana har abada
outcome.answer: An tabbatar da rashin laifina lokacin da ɗana jariri ya yi magana

verse: Then he called her from below her, 'Do not grieve; your Lord has provided beneath you a stream. And shake toward you the trunk of the palm tree; it will drop upon you ripe, fresh dates.' (Maryam 19:24-25)
arabic: فَنَادَىٰهَا مِن تَحْتِهَا أَلَّا تَحْزَنِي قَدْ جَعَلَ رَبُّكِ تَحْتَكِ سَرِيًّا ﴿٢٤﴾ وَهُزِّي إِلَيْكِ بِجِذْعِ النَّخْلَةِ تُسَاقِطْ عَلَيْكِ رُطَبًا جَنِيًّا ﴿٢٥﴾
